name: UDF Extraction via Candidate Directions
aliases: UDF depth estimation from candidate directions
definition: A method to estimate the Unoriented Distance Field (UDF) value and the optimal direction v* at a query point p by using a small SIREN network to generate Kc candidate directions, computing associated distances and visibility, and aggregating them with softmax weights.
summary: UDF Extraction via Candidate Directions estimates unoriented distance fields by aggregating pre-generated candidate directions with softmax weights, providing a stable alternative to noisy gradient-based methods.
